BioShock Movie Is Still Happening, But Director Says It’s A “Tough Nut To Crack”
items.description: A BioShock movie at Netflix remains in development, its director has confirmed, but that doesn't necessarily mean it'll ever be made. Francis Lawrence confirmed to The Direct that he hopes to make the BioShock movie, but "it's tricky on a couple fronts." Lawrence said he is "definitely active" in working on the BioShock movie, but "it is a tough nut to crack that world and that story." items.description: Originally set to enter early access on October 27, action-adventure RPG Emberville has been delayed by over two months to January 7, 2027.
